scope: AX-03B1 standalone atomic read-only observation snapshot
covered: no-publication BEGIN and no-session reads return SLVERR
complete frozen payload and epoch across publications
duplicate and out-of-order words; explicit re-BEGIN
misaligned and out-of-range reads preserve session
R data/response stability and blocked AR under backpressure
held concurrent AR accepted only after preceding R response
terminal response handshake releases bank; early terminal is explicit release
simultaneous BEGIN/publication returns prior complete frame
uint32 sequence wrap and sticky wrap flag
invalid-quality observation still transports opaque payload
reset cancels stalled response and invalidates both banks
external new epoch distinguishes reused sequence after reset
limitations: single clock and single globally serialized reader session
no board base address or write/control channels
epoch label is caller-supplied, not a persistent hardware boot counter
header availability is not ADC/calibration/physical validity or power permission
